agent.problem: The earlier cards only say that Jeremiah is to pass the cup around. They give no basis for choosing “nations” over “priests” or “prophets,” so the blank asks the baker to guess wording they have not seen rather than reason out the meaning.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
